Messages.Author: Gabriel
Messages.Body:
Can you play action modifier, reaction and combat cards for other
Methuselah's minions? For instance can I give my prey's prey a +1 intercept
with enhanced senses or play a thrown gate for them?

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:


No. Those cards are only able to be used for the vampires that you
control unless there is specific card text to the contrary...for example,
Nosferatu Putresence.

Noal
